Preliminary Inquiry (PI) to identify and select companies that are interested in and capable of manufacturing the Liquid Nitrogen (LIN) infrastructure for the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) and installing it at ELT site in northern Chile, at ca. 3,000 meters above sea level. The PI will be released in Q3/2022 to potential suppliers in the ESO Member States and Chile and will be followed by a Call for tender planned to be issued in Q4/2022. The scope of work includes system design, manufacture, verification testing and transportation to the ELT site in Chile. It also includes installation and acceptance testing at the ELT Observatory in collaboration with ESO, anticipated to take place in the first half of 2026. The LIN infrastructure system is spread over various locations inside of the multi-storey ELT building. It is an automated closed circuit distribution system, composed of cryogenic industry standards such as pressurized LIN phase-separators and storage tanks (3000-4000 L volume), several hundred metres of vacuum-insulated interconnection piping (size DN 20-63), automatic LIN supply and level control, Nitrogen gas exhaust system with gas heaters, cryogenic valves and safety installations. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q2/2023 to the Bidder which has submitted a fully compliant Tender and offers the best value for money for ESO, taking into account the quality and price of the offer.
